The helper deliberately implements the **fresh private-run subset**, not the upgrade/general resolver: any legacy entry, including a dangling symlink, is refused; an overlong runtime candidate uses the safe short test-state fallback; if neither fits, it refuses rather than taking the product's legacy fallback.

Process recovery still excludes baseline identities and uses uid/start-time checks plus pidfd signalling; recovery/errors disqualify acceptance. No new broad deletion or process-matching path was added. The inherited harness's saved-endpoint, claimed-daemon and positive-control sentinel cleanup remains unchanged.
